subject: tests read tests.unittest.map / base from board/config.json instead of a hand-copied GATE_MAP (one fact, one place; D-054 Q12)
objective: Adding a test module or a map row means editing board/config.json only. tests/test_adapter_unittest.py stops carrying GATE_MAP / HARNESS_IDS / VERIFY_IDS / REPO_MAP_IDS / BASE_IDS (lines 26-91 at base 8d2cd91, a row-by-row copy of tests.unittest.map + base; its original purpose - cross-checking gate.sh map() - is gone since #162 deleted map()). It reads the rows from the config and asserts behaviour and structure only. Same fix for the other copies found by grep: tests/test_verify_runner.py test_map_is_the_only_copy pins len(rows) == 48 and test_base_is_the_four_base_ids pins the literal base list. Symptom: #160 land red three times and the #164 merge collided on this duplicated table.
acceptance: A1 (tests/test_adapter_unittest.py, Select): for every row of board/config.json tests.unittest.map read at test time, the representative path (row.match with each '*' replaced by 'zzz') fed alone to 'adapter-unittest.py select --mode branch' prints exactly set(row.ids), no 'unmapped', no duplicate line; rows whose representative path matches tests/test_*.py (built-in arm) are skipped by name. The file no longer defines GATE_MAP, HARNESS_IDS, VERIFY_IDS, REPO_MAP_IDS or BASE_IDS (grep '^GATE_MAP\|^BASE_IDS' -> 0).

A2 (same file): '--mode base' output equals the config's tests.unittest.base read at test time (replaces the BASE_IDS literal at line 240). The existing synthetic-config cases stay as they are and keep pinning behaviour: test_first_match_wins_and_empty_ids_is_not_unmapped, test_unknown_file_is_unmapped_and_test_files_are_built_in, test_several_files_are_deduped_in_order, #166 deleted-module case.

A3 structural checks on the real config (tests/test_verify_runner.py replaces the len(rows) == 48 and literal-base asserts): map has > 10 rows (precondition: the table was read); no duplicate match; every id in map and base names an existing tests/<id>.py; no row is shadowed by an earlier row (its representative path also fnmatches an earlier match -> red, naming both rows). gate.sh still carries no map() / BASE= copy (keep those two asserts).

A4 mutations, each red then reverted (worker, EVIDENCE table): m1 add a config row with ids ['test_zzz_missing'] -> A3 red; m2 move 'verify/*' above 'verify/TAGS.d/*' -> A3 shadow red; m3 adapter select lets a later matching row add its ids -> test_first_match_wins red; m4 adapter select ignores the map -> A1 red. Adding a new valid row to the config alone keeps all of these green (no test edit).

A5 full suite green: 'sh scripts/gate.sh --full' rc 0 (after #169 lands, on its base); timeout 590 python3 -m unittest tests.test_adapter_unittest tests.test_verify_runner tests.test_memory_lifecycle tests.test_retire_sync green in the foreground first.
test_plan: Unit layer only. Oracle = board/config.json read by the test with json.load (the fact under test is the adapter's reading of it, not the content); representative paths are derived mechanically ('*' -> 'zzz'; measured at 8d2cd91: 48 rows, 10 glob rows, none use '?' or '[', 0 rows shadowed, every id has tests/<id>.py). First-match-wins and empty-ids stay pinned by the existing synthetic config in a tempdir (AC_ROOT=tmp). Run: timeout 590 python3 -m unittest tests.test_adapter_unittest tests.test_verify_runner; then gate --full. No kill/os.kill/pkill lines in tests (hard_block). Container is uid 0 - nothing here depends on permissions.
outline: D-054 Q12 one fact one place.
